method: Static IDA pseudocode/disassembly and original bytes; source/JSON/AST/lexical review only. No game function, generator, compiler, test, benchmark, GUI, CI or package execution.

native_evidence.finding: Action table count header+0x27c7988, pointer+0x27c7990, stride72, signed id<count comparison. Reader additionally rejects negative IDs and caps count at0x20000. Record+4 u16 opcode, +16 eight signed params, +48 ratio and +52..68 AI parameters.

Downloaded data29 stores record ID at+0, name/help pool indices at+8/+12, opcode+4, skp1..8 at+16, ratio+48 and aip0..4 at+52. Metadata header+0x27c7980 is native format/version/count/checksum; no string pool is read by diagnostics.

data029.bin loader enforces serialized format4, caps count0x20000, allocates72*count and loads raw record fields. Header metadata and content hashes retained, but full native checksum is not executed or claimed verified.

Enemy slot initialized at impl+753464+i*2984. Actual param subobject begins+536; level comes from spawn descriptor+8 and is stored u16+312. AI flags/counter/action count+1720/+1724/+1728, budget+2004 and packed compound+2012 reset here. Parts flag0x100 requires a separate model.

Enemy parameter init stores actual catalog ID at subobject+44 (enemy+580) and pointer at+0 (enemy+536). Derived HP64+56/+72 and attack64+88/+104 include dungeon scaling; do not recalculate from ordinary card defaults.

Normal IDs index840-byte catalog rows; special IDs use modulo100000 then +828 links, bounded128. Allocation count save+0x5ef15c distinguishes ordinary count+0x5ef158. Reader checks exact pointer and ID and refuses extra helper ID10000000.

Reads all64 rows at parameter+236 with stride8; zero IDs are skipped. Uses flags/control helper, budgets, HP, feasibility, weights and RNG. Source flags at parameter+224 bit1 choose this selector; the alternative is0x10055ede0. Never invoke either for observation.

Control helper mutates AI flags/counter and cursor. Selected descriptions only:0x15..26 excluding gaps,0x2b..2d,0x5b. HP<= and>= at0x10055bf30/58 use actual scalar UCVTF (pseudocode aliases misleading).0x17 and0x5b store B-1 then caller increments, while HP/counter/level and0x2b store B-2 then increment. Final zero-based targets B and B-1 respectively. No predicates executed by this parser.

Dispatcher uses compound continuation, cached selection path, two selectors; increments action count and AI budget, subtracts cost and sets rootID<<9|0xf0. Selected/cached fields do not alone identify the next action.

Compound83 uses low nibble progress to fetch positive child IDs from record+16, terminates on nonpositive, skips82 or infeasible child. No proven eight-child index stop. Preserve eight raw params and positive prefix, mark all-eight-positive unterminated, nested compounds and cycles unknown.

Positive action record+68 becomes enemy+2024 percent and prepends attack animation.0x100566a0c executes it through0x100569f34 before the action effect. Relation only labeled for recognized status effects88/141; other opcodes retained raw.
Effect88 increases signed ten-bit awoken-bind duration impl+738908 and updates effective team state. Kind recognized only; no duration/healing/survival simulation.
Effect141 sets assist-void duration impl+739980 with fresh bit, updates members. Recognized as assist void, not assist consumption.

Attack64 enemy+624/+640, multiply by coefficient and active enrage(+2128 float/+2144 signed16), round, optional fixed override, add and clear protected+2032. Layered shields/resistance round after each stage; resolve and special-mode branches. Current values do not establish future shield lifetime or an upper damage bound.
Countdown reset usually uses parameter+100 but dungeon/special state overrides exist. Countdown decrementation and post-player-attack scheduling remain unverified; expose raw countdown only.
Negative selected ID can execute default normal attack while action flag is active. Empty table/negative selection must never become a zero-damage next-turn forecast.

scope.budget_excludes: Table headers, existing read-only automation/member checks, code guards, cross-observation check and final existing board read. Reported counters are for one collection, not total diagnostic duration.
scope.sampling: Existing optional observation interval0.75s, public age<=1.5s. Independent dictionary outside copied PHOrbSnapshot.

unsupported: complete selector control flow, feasibility, random branch set and side effects
default attack, fixed or percentage attacks and multihit event semantics
post-player-action enemy HP interval, killing, resurrection and next-floor preemptives
future effective shield duration/recomputation and elemental resistance
cleanse deadlines, assist-overcharge scheduling and required-rescue deferral
L+heart-four survival stall with T omitted
whole catalog native checksum and device read cost

written_cases.parser: duplicate child order/dedup, positive prefix/raw suffix, eight-positive unterminated, unknown opcode, invalid/unreadable IDs, cyclic/nested/deep graphs, shared record cap, jump target conventions, bind/fallback never guessed attack
written_cases.native: all64 rows/gaps, variant identity, attack/enrage/countdown raw, attached attack, exact hashes, no guest changes/native helper calls, corrupt/NaN stats, bounds/parts,12 races, coherent HP with earlier observation, empty table, shared byte budget, multiple enemies, independent guard failure, all multiplayer exclusions; positive supported baseline, SHA-256 abc known vector, 64-bit high halves/sign bounds, invalid short encoding, HP above maximum, direct phase22/held window, catalog link cycle
written_cases.session: current table presentation, no forecast promotion, throttling, stale clearing, independent failure, board/context invalidation and all multiplayer exclusions

static_audit.limits: No compilation, case execution, selector/AI execution, native timing, device, shield/healing, survival or performance result.

header_declaration_review.finding: CC_SHA256 declares API_AVAILABLE(macos(10.4), ios(2.0)) with no deprecation annotation; libSystem linkage documented.
header_declaration_review.limit: Upstream header review only. No local Apple SDK or compilation checked.
